name: Square-Amalgam Obstruction
definition: The displayed class in $Q_6$ whose low-bit vertex-incidence mask is `0xdf1b101000111011`; bit $j$ records the word with integer encoding $j$.
properties: An 18-vertex ample VC-dimension-two partial cube that is pc-minimal outside the cover-recursively peripheral class. It has no cut vertex and is the gated amalgam of two copies of the eleven-vertex rooted factor $\mathcal L_4$ along a maximal square. Up to cube isomorphism it is the unique ample periphery-free partial cube of isometric dimension six and order at most eighteen. Its unique proper gated two-cover is this square sum, and it is face-critical.
